versions.changelog:
- Added a platform × endpoint support matrix, detailing feature support for each OTA.
- Expanded documentation on async handling and error responses, including polling, status handling, and rate limits.
- Updated the cross-OTA advantage section to clarify how price comparison and offers work across platforms.
- Added a "Known limitations" section about pagination, externally-sourced IDs, and platform gaps.
- Metadata tags updated: category changed from "travel" to "integrations".
- Removed unused skill-card.md file.

- Initial release of the Booking.com search skill.
- Search live Booking.com stays by location, dates, and occupancy via StayingAPI.
- Unified results schema compatible with other platforms like Airbnb, Vrbo, and Google Hotels.
- Requires a StayingAPI key (`STAYINGAPI_KEY`) for all API requests.
- Simple setup with no additional dependencies or runtimes needed.
